scripts.dev: npx -y concurrently -k -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.test:e2e: npm --prefix frontend run test:browser && npm --prefix frontend run test:browser-notifications
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run check
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:scripts && npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.release:verify: npm test && npm run check && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
